Here we compare the different models for the same sampling approach

```{r,echo=FALSE,include=FALSE}
source('../scripts/fitModels.R')
```

# BPOT
```{r,echo=FALSE,warning=FALSE}
all_bpot_results <- list("logistic"= log_M,
                    "neglogistic"= neglog_M,
                    "hr"= hr_M,
                    "ct"= ct_M,
                    "alogistic"= alog_M,
                    "aneglogistic"= aneglog_M,
                    "bilogistic"= bilog_M)
summarise_bpot(all_bpot_results,severity = pis0, severity_age = pis1)
all_bpot_densities <- lapply(all_bpot_results, function(x) x$plot_df)
plot_crash_severity(all_bpot_densities,injury_df = injury_df)
```


# CBPOT
```{r,echo=FALSE,warning=FALSE}


all_cbpot_results <- list("gumbel"= gumbel_M,
                    "clayton"= clayton_M,
                    "gaussian"= gaussian_M)
summarise_cbpot(all_cbpot_results,severity = pis0, severity_age = pis1)
all_cbpot_densities <- lapply(all_cbpot_results, function(x) x$plot_df_q)
plot_crash_severity(all_cbpot_densities,injury_df = injury_df)
```
